issues.jp_before: 事故[じこ]で、電車[でんしゃ]が駅[えき]に{止[と]まっています|tr-teiru-tearu}。
issues.problem: Distractor 止めてあります (が + transitive てある) is grammatical and arguably fits 'the train is stopped' (staff stopped it).
issues.action: Replaced distractor with ungrammatical 止まってあります.

issues.jp_before: この本[ほん]は、ページが{破[やぶ]れています|tr-teiru-tearu}。
issues.problem: Nothing in the sentence excludes 破ってあります (someone tore it out); 'A page is torn' fits both.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with ungrammatical 破れてあります.

issues.jp_before: このスプーンが{曲[ま]がっています|tr-teiru-tearu}ね。
issues.problem: 曲げてあります ('has been bent') is grammatical and fits 'This spoon is bent'; no context rules it out.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with ungrammatical 曲がってあります.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]なので、銀行[ぎんこう]のドアが{閉[し]まっています|tr-teiru-tearu}。
issues.problem: 閉めてあります is fully natural here (staff closed the door for the night) and matches the English.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with ungrammatical 閉まってあります.

issues.jp_before: シャツのボタンが{外[はず]れています|tr-teiru-tearu}よ。
issues.problem: 外してあります (deliberately unbuttoned) is grammatical; only the English excludes it.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with ungrammatical 外れてあります.

issues.jp_before: 重[おも]い荷物[にもつ]を、先[さき]にホテルに{届[とど]けてあります|tr-teiru-tearu}。
issues.problem: English 'I have had the luggage sent' implies a causative/delivery service not in the Japanese.
issues.action: English changed to 'I have already taken the heavy luggage to the hotel ahead of time.'

issues.jp_before: 燃[も]えるごみを、玄関[げんかん]に{出[だ]してあります|tr-teiru-tearu}。
issues.problem: Putting trash out 'at the entrance' (玄関) is an odd scene; 玄関 also overused in the file.
issues.action: Changed 玄関に to ごみ置き場に and English to 'at the collection point'.

issues.jp_before: 行[い]きたい店[みせ]には、地図[ちず]に印[しるし]を{つけてあります|tr-teiru-tearu}。
issues.problem: Two clashing に (店には / 地図に) make the sentence awkward.
issues.action: Changed 店には to 店は.
